course.title: Site and Area Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: For redesigning old Dhaka, as a site planner you have freedom to demolish (10) all the structures. On the other hand, you may consider some site planning tools to develop the area and make it more accessible. Which one will you prefer? Justify your answer.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2014
